rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Ambush Beacon
rules.description: Friendly units using Ambush may ignore distance restrictions from enemies if they are deployed within 6" of this model.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: Anti-Cover Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Anti-Cover on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Armor
rules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

rules.name: Bounding
rules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

rules.name: Caster
rules.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell’s effect. Models within 18” of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

rules.name: Casting Buff
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 12" with Caster, which gets +1 to casting rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

rules.name: Clan Warrior
rules.description: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

rules.name: Counter
rules.description: May strike first with this weapon when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.

rules.name: Counter in Melee Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Counter on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Destructive
rules.description: When attacking units with more than half of their total size or Tough value (for single-model units), those hits get AP(+1).

rules.name: Enhanced Clan Warrior
rules.description: If this model has Clan Warrior, it gets extra attacks on successful unmodified hit results of 5-6 from Clan Warrior (instead of only on 6).

rules.name: Enhanced Clan Warrior Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Clan Warrior. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Enhanced Predator
rules.description: If this model has Predator, it gets extra attacks on successful unmodified hit results of 5-6 from Predator (instead of only on 6).

rules.name: Fear
rules.description: When in melee with this model, enemies count as having taken +X wounds when checking who won.

rules.name: Fearless
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test, roll one die. On a 4+ it counts as passed instead.

rules.name: Fearless Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Fearless. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Flying
rules.description: May move through units and terrain, and ignores the effects of Difficult and Dangerous terrain it doesn’t start its move in.This unit automatically passes jumping rolls.

rules.name: Fortified
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

rules.name: Hero
rules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

rules.name: Imprecise
rules.description: Gets -1 to hit when attacking.

rules.name: Piercing Marksman
rules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model's weapons get AP(+1).

rules.name: Piercing Marksman Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Piercing Marksman. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Precision Fighter
rules.description: This model gets +1 to hit rolls in melee.

rules.name: Precision Fighter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to hit rolls in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Predator
rules.description: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

rules.name: Rapid Advance
rules.description: This model moves +4" when using Advance actions.

rules.name: Rapid Advance Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Rapid Advance. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Rapid Charge Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game moves +4" when using Charge actions. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Repel Ambushers
rules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

rules.name: Stealth
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Stealth Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Teleport
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

rules.name: Unique Hero
rules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Vengeance
rules.description: When this unit is fully destroyed, place as many Vengeance tokens on the unit that destroyed it as models with this rule in this unit at the beginning of the game. Friendly units get +X to hit rolls when attacking that unit, where X is the number of tokens on it.

rules.name: Versatile Expert
rules.description: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) on their weapons, or get +1 to hit rolls.

spells.name: Dragon Breath
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 3 hits.

spells.name: Eternal Guidance
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +6" range on their weapons when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Mind Vortex
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 6", which take 4 hits with AP(2) each.

spells.name: Soul Spear
spells.effect: Pick one enemy model within 30" in line of sight, which takes 3 hits with AP(3) and Destructive. This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].

spells.name: Spirit Power
spells.effect: Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Flying once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Spirit Resolve
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Clan Warrior once (next time the effect would apply).
